services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Our camps combine a carefully crafted blend of science, exploration, games and crafts providing children the opportunity to learn and play throughout the beauty of VanDusen Botanical Garden, while fostering positive stewardship of the environment. Days are spent almost entirely outdoors with access to indoor and covered spaces available in extreme weather. Our outdoor camps create a unique learning experience tailored for children ages 5-10. Please note that all campers must be at least 5 years old and have completed or currently be attending kindergarten. services.name: Guided Garden Tours
services.desc: Bloedel Conservatory is a domed lush paradise located in Queen Elizabeth Park atop the City of Vancouver’s highest point. Tropical birds, koi fish, and over 500 exotic plants and flowers thrive within its temperature-controlled environment. Tickets are available online or at the admission desk. Save when you book online! View opening hours here. Bloedel Conservatory is home to over 500 plants from tropical and subtropical rainforest habitats, along with a variety of exotic birds-all of the large perch birds at the Conservatory are rescues. The koi pond is another highlight, featuring Dragon Gate, believed to be the oldest koi fish in Vancouver. Originally brought to Vancouver for Expo 86’,
